svg.title: Ramps and the centered sum
svg.desc: Computed. Left: the weighted ramps Lambda(n)(y/n-1)_+ for prime powers n <= 13, each switching on at y = n with slope Lambda(n)/n. Right: their full sum minus y log y - (1+gamma) y, i.e. G(y), for 1 <= y <= 120; it hovers around log 2pi (dashed), the residue at s = 0.
